statement: For fixed capacity, applying the same coordinate permutation to a binary decision vector and its matching nonnegative demand vector preserves load, overload and physical feasibility.
preconditions: decision and demand vectors have the same positive length
capacity is a fixed nonnegative integer
the transform is one bijection applied identically to both vectors

transform_convention.definition: For permutation p, transformed[j] = original[p[j]] for both decision and demand vectors.
transform_convention.pairing_rule: A decision bit and its matching demand must move together.

development_fixture.decision_domain: all 2^3 = 8 binary vectors in lexicographic product order
development_fixture.permutation_domain: all 3! = 6 coordinate permutations in lexicographic order

excluded_claims: auxiliary consistency is preserved when slack-bit meanings are permuted or changed
QUBO energy is invariant under arbitrary variable or coefficient reordering
permuting only decisions or only demands preserves load
planned_checks: retain exactly 8 identity and 40 nonidentity cases
load is equal before and after every simultaneous permutation
overload is equal before and after every simultaneous permutation
physical feasibility is equal before and after every simultaneous permutation
decision-only and demand-only transforms are rejected as outside preconditions
retain every case and any counterexample
limitations: Freezing and validating this contract does not execute P02.
The future audit is limited to one static three-item synthetic capacity fixture.
The property is a relabeling symmetry of a dot product, not evidence of quantum advantage or real-microgrid performance.
